query:
UPDATE whatsappSessions ws1
JOIN (
  SELECT requestId, approverId, MAX(id) as maxId
  FROM whatsappSessions
  WHERE status = 'pending'
  GROUP BY requestId, approverId
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) ws2 ON ws1.requestId = ws2.requestId AND ws1.approverId = ws2.approverId
SET ws1.status = 'expired'
WHERE ws1.status = 'pending'
  AND ws1.id < ws2.maxId;
